CustomField.description: Formula text that builds a usable image URL from Form_Banner_Image__c (returns blank when that field is empty). Provides the resolved banner image link. Not consumed by the current formTemplatePageSection render path; system-derived and not editable.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only banner image URL calculated from the Form Banner Image field. To change it, update Form Banner Image rather than this field.
CustomField.label: Form Banner Image URL
